visualCharacteristics: Section title (h2 section face) on the 4/8/12-col grid, left or centred, optionally on a dark or ice band, with optional body copy or a ghost 'View all' button on the right.
contentPattern: One cell with a heading and optional paragraphs; with insights, link-only paragraphs become the right-hand CTA; spacing tokens t-/tm-/b-/bm-/w-<n> set margins and width.
usage: Use to introduce a page section with a standalone title, optionally with lead copy or a 'View all' link.
reuseGuidance: Reuse above any module needing a title by authoring a heading in one cell and adding alignment, band or spacing options.
